description.value: Fatburger is a classic burger chain with roots going back to a 1947 Los Angeles hamburger stand, now Canadian-owned and operated since 2005. The Kamloops location at Summit Drive serves build-your-own burgers made with fresh, never-frozen Alberta Angus beef, alongside chicken, plant-based options, and hand-scooped milkshakes. Every order is cooked-to-order, making it a solid stop for a hot, customizable meal mid-ride.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Fatburger Canada website confirms an active Kamloops location at #5A – 1200 Summit Dr, with phone 778-471-4707 matching OSM. OSM 'takeaway=yes' is corroborated by the website's prominent 'ORDER TAKE-OUT OR DELIVERY' call-to-action; plant-based burgers are explicitly listed on the website, confirming vegetarian/vegan options. No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM 'address' field is empty; full address (#5A – 1200 Summit Dr, Kamloops, BC V2C 6L2) was sourced from the website. OSM does carry 'addr:unit=5A' which is consistent.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible fast-food restaurant confirmed by an active website. A straightforward food and drink stop for touring cyclists.
